notes.title: New Mode Update : O Village
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience and understanding.

[b]<O Village> [/b]mode has been updated!

This mode is for 4 to 12 players.
Solve (or cause) the events that unfold in <O Village>, a fictional town with an impressive clock tower.
Take on a different role each time and try to pull off a victorious ending or create a spectacular scene with your impressive acting!

The protagonist wins by banishing all antagonists or completing a certain number of missions placed throughout the village.
Antagonists and Variants will prevent you from winning easily, so keep an eye on your surroundings!

Antagonists win when the combined number of Protagonists and Variants is equal to or less than the number of antagonists.
Try to eliminate everyone but the Antagonist, but always be careful or you'll get kicked out!

Each Variants has special victory conditions.
Hide your identity and fulfill the special conditions to win alone!

notes.title: New Features and Updates in Animalism
notes.content:
[h1][b]Game Settings Menu:[/b][/h1]

Key Bindings: Customize key settings for more flexible control.
Audio Settings: Adjust volume levels and enable voice features.
Resolution Options: Now supports a variety of resolutions for improved display flexibility.
In-Game Voice Control: Manage other players' voice levels dynamically during gameplay.

[h1][b]Room Settings Menu:[/b][/h1]

Room Customization: Tailor your room settings to attract the right players for your game.
Mode Selection: Choose from a variety of game modes for different play experiences.
Mode Customization: Personalize game modes to suit your preferences and match the skill level of the room.

[h1][b]O'Village Expansion:[/b][/h1]

New Items (7 Types): Each with unique effects to enhance gameplay.
New Jobs (10 Types): Introducing a variety of gimmicks and abilities.
New Missions (80 Types): Enjoy a wide array of mini-games, each offering different challenges and fun.

notes.title: Update on Current Beta Test
notes.content:
The implemented features include a store, room search, game description window, and infection mode. You can purchase items in the store with Gold Jelly, while Royal Jelly can be bought with real money. Create a room and invite four or more users to join and play together. Refer to the game description window for rules.

Enjoy the updates and please let us know if you have any feedback via email or comments.
